what: LE4 Layer X baseline: in-process burns at today's default LayerXSettings

he_pad.label: Helium hot-fire drawing, on the pad, erosion replay on

checks.detail: Estimated, not measured or from a datasheet: TK-LOX 1015 psi, TK-FUEL 1015 psi, COPV-HE 6765 psi. The MAWP checks and the optimiser's tank-pressure ceiling stand on these.
The drawing's tank is 15.10 L; the config's is 6.44 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.
The drawing's tank is 8.67 L; the config's is 6.20 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.

Locked up at 564.7 psia from a 4515 psia bottle, the bottle should end near 1783 psia after giving the tanks ~0.083 kg of Helium; the regulator's supply-pressure effect then lifts the tanks to ~611 psia (+46 psi). Estimated from the drawing's regulator law at zero flow, the bottle on its isentrope and the gas at the bottle's temperature: an upper estimate; the burn grades the real peak. That is over the design's LOX tank cap (600 psi, design_requirements.max_lox_tank_pressure_psi, read as psia until AUDIT D11 is decided); the design's fuel tank cap (600 psi, design_requirements.max_fuel_tank_pressure_psi, read as psia until AUDIT D11 is decided).
67 library default(s), 125 assumed value(s) in total; listed under Details.

gn2_pad.label: GN2 drawing (the Layer X tab's default drawing), on the pad

checks.detail: Estimated, not measured or from a datasheet: TK-LOX 1015 psi, TK-FUEL 1015 psi, COPV-GN2 6765 psi. The MAWP checks and the optimiser's tank-pressure ceiling stand on these.

LOX at 90.0 K (the drawing's OXT temperature, measured); nitrogen condenses there above 52.3 psia, its saturation pressure (CoolProp). At 565 psia lockup the ullage's nitrogen is at 550 psia (lockup less LOX's 14.4 psia vapour pressure), so it condenses into the propellant and on the cold tank wall. Run anyway as asked (ack_gn2_condensation): the condensation is not modelled, so the pressurant use and the LOX tank's pressure read optimistic.
The drawing's tank is 15.10 L; the config's is 6.44 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.
The drawing's tank is 8.67 L; the config's is 6.20 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.

Locked up at 564.7 psia from a 4515 psia bottle, the bottle should end near 1472 psia after giving the tanks ~0.610 kg of Nitrogen; the regulator's supply-pressure effect then lifts the tanks to ~616 psia (+52 psi). Estimated from the drawing's regulator law at zero flow, the bottle on its isentrope and the gas at the bottle's temperature: an upper estimate; the burn grades the real peak. That is over the design's LOX tank cap (600 psi, design_requirements.max_lox_tank_pressure_psi, read as psia until AUDIT D11 is decided); the design's fuel tank cap (600 psi, design_requirements.max_fuel_tank_pressure_psi, read as psia until AUDIT D11 is decided).
